title: Soviet military exercise drew UFOs once nuclear weapons were brought in
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Soviet military exercise drew UFOs once nuclear weapons were brought in, about Soviet era at Soviet Union, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's he's on video on the internet saying that uh at some point during the Soviet era he was part of a military exercise uh that was intentionally designed to try to attract UFOs

plain: A researcher named Robert Hastings, who studies reports of UFOs around nuclear weapons sites, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a retired Soviet army colonel who appears in a video online. Hastings says the colonel described taking part, during the Soviet era, in a military exercise deliberately designed to attract UFOs, and that they showed up once nuclear weapons were brought in. If true, it would suggest whatever is behind UFOs takes a particular interest in nuclear weapons.
